newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia to release CFT data with review.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia to release CFT data with review.

text.p: The Australian government said on Tuesday it was likely to release the November statement of Commonwealth Government Financial Transactions (CFT) in conjunction with the upcoming mid-year budget review.

The government was initially expected to release the November CFT on Monday, but a spokesman for Finance Minister John Fahey said it was now seen as more sensible to release it at the same time as the mid-year review.
The spokesman said the mid-year review would be released sometime before January 25. Treasurer Peter Costello is due back from holidays on January 20.

For the 12 months to October, the underlying budget deficit was A$13.3 billion, little improved on previous months, and compared with the government's forecast of a A$5.6 billion deficit for the 12 months to June 1997.
October alone produced an underlying deficit of A$4.4 billion.
